meta.citation: Probative. (2026). Railroad casualties and crossing incidents by county (FRA Forms 55a, 57 and 54) (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23753016
meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of events railroads reported to the Federal Railroad Administration, kept for research and market sizing. A report is not a finding of fault, and it says nothing about whether anyone has a claim; a railroad employee's injury claim has its own federal rules and deadlines. Questions about an injury are for a licensed attorney.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.
